title: Stage-Pillar Heading Disambiguation in Markdown AST Parsers
author: Harness Reflector (harness-reflector)
context: Agent skill specification files (SKILL.md) declare execution stages via numbered markdown headings and foundational craft pillars (The Visual Brief, The Mandatory Checkpoint, Explicit Anti-Patterns). The SkillCardParser service uses the regular expression r'^(?:##|###)\s+(\d+)\.\s+(.+)$' to automatically extract execution stages.
distilled_learning: # Stage-Pillar Heading Disambiguation in Markdown AST Parsers

claims.assertion: SkillCardParser._extract_stages_from_skill_md matches level-2 and level-3 numbered headings matching r'^(?:##|###)\s+(\d+)\.', misidentifying numbered pillar sections as execution stages.
Roman numeral heading prefixes ('### Pillar I: ...') avoid the integer regex match while fully satisfying SkillPillarRule validation checks.
Contract tests in test_brain_artifact_miner.py assert exact 5-stage extraction after Roman numeral pillar disambiguation.
